name: Jacqueline White and the Ghost Pilot
source:
A virtual kinetic novel. A lone Nieuport observation aeroplane is returning from the WW1 front line. It's badly shot up. The engine is on the verge of failing. Who is piloting the plane?

[From [url=https://per-k-grok.itch.io/jacqueline-white-and-the-ghost-pilot] itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一部虚拟动态小说。一架孤独的纽波特侦察机正从第一次世界大战前线返航。飞机伤痕累累，发动机也濒临熄火。究竟是谁在驾驶这架飞机？

（来源：[url=https://per-k-grok.itch.io/jacqueline-white-and-the-ghost-pilot]itch.io[/url]）
